text: In a village east of Bangkok, Mak goes off to war leaving his pregnant young wife Nak, and returns wounded to find her waiting with their baby. The villagers know Nak died months before, and those who try to tell him [are killed in the night|threat|the restless dead]. Beneath the house Mak finds a corpse, and through the floorboards watches [Nak's arm stretch to the ground for a dropped comb|images|wounded and changing bodies], a ghost [desperate to keep her husband|wants|a lover to possess] as the villagers burn her house and [summon an exorcist|rules|faith and charms protect].
